# parity-fuzz --mode split baseline: normalized signatures of KNOWN gaps.
# A divergence whose signature is here is allowed; a NEW one fails CI.
# Regenerate: parity-fuzz --mode split --count N --verify 3  (copy NEW-signature lines).
#
# No known gaps — 4000 cases run clean (two seeds).
#
# Covers word splitting driven by IFS and the SH_WORD_SPLIT family: quoted vs
# unquoted expansion, `${=v}` forced splitting, and the whitespace vs
# non-whitespace separator rule — a run of WHITESPACE separators collapses to one
# break, a non-whitespace one does not, so `a::b` under IFS=: yields an EMPTY
# middle field. Values are chosen with leading/trailing/doubled separators so the
# split is decided entirely by IFS.
#
# The mode already existed and ran clean, but was NOT gated in CI, so nothing
# stopped a regression in it. Gating is what makes that clean run mean
# something. `trap` and `redir` sat in exactly this state and each turned out
# to be hiding real bugs once their vocabulary was widened — a clean ungated
# mode is an untested mode, not a correct one.
#
# BACKSLASH-NEWLINE in `(z)` (fixed in subst.rs): the value pool now includes
# `$'foo\\\nbar'` / `$'a \\\nb'` (a literal backslash then a real newline) and
# the `(z)` probe prints the JOINED word content, not just the count — because a
# `\<NL>` line continuation collapses `foo\<NL>bar` to the single word `foobar`
# (word count stays 1; only the content changes). zsh removes `\<NL>` and joins;
# the port kept both chars. Reverting the fix yields 18 divergences on seed 1.
# The `(z)` words are captured QUOTED (`"${(@z)v}"`) so the separate
# SH_WORD_SPLIT+IFS re-split path (`zz=(${(z)v})` with `IFS=:`, still divergent)
# is not conflated with this. Bug #1016.
#
# `(0)` NUL SPLIT + MULTI-CHAR `(s:SEP:)` (verified-correct coverage): the mode
# generated only single-char `(s.X.)` / `(ps.X.)`, so NUL-delimited splitting
# (c:subst.c:2293) and separators longer than one char (c:2299 get_strarg) were
# uncompared. A dedicated probe now exercises `${(0)v}` (incl. `(@0)`
# empty-preservation, `$'…\0…'` values), `${(s:--:)v}` / `${(s:XY:)v}`
# multi-char, and `${(ps.::.)v}` empty-preservation. All hand-verified equal.
#
# PARTIALLY FIXED / still-divergent (docs/BUGS.md #1018/#1017): the nested
# split-with-trailing-empty collapse (`${${(f)$'one\n'}[1]}`) is FIXED for the
# QUOTED subscript/splat/no-op forms (gated in the `subexp` mode). STILL OPEN and
# NOT generated here: (a) the `${#${(f)v}}` length form and UNQUOTED
# `${${(f)v}[1]}` form (they collapse earlier via PREFORK_SINGLE, #1018); (b)
# `zz=(${(z)v})` unquoted under SH_WORD_SPLIT with `IFS=:` re-splits the `(z)`
# words and drops empties unlike zsh (#1017).
#
# Any divergence here is a regression.
